steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0076 worktree and branch from main.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the standard task folder layout.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Find canonical MOD-file sources (ModelDB, Allen Institute) for the 6-7 new channels (Kdr, KM, HCN, CaL, CaT, BK, SK).

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Map reusable code from t0024 (cell builder + parametric synapse placer scaffolding), t0066 (PD/ND bar-angle protocol + tuning curve), t0067 (5 vendored MODs), t0072 (per-synapse recorder + Typst PDF pipeline).

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Write plan/plan.md: 25-d parameter space, BoTorch qNEHVI design, parametric synapse placer, trial driver, MOD-vendor list with sources, Vast.ai instance spec.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision the Vast.ai 64-core CPU node, install NEURON + project deps via uv sync, compile the t0076 MOD library on the remote, smoke-test one trial.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run BoTorch qNEHVI optimisation: 30 Sobol DoE + 300-500 acquisition steps; 8 directions x 20 seeds per cell; 25-d input -> (DSI, PD firing rate); save aggregated trial results, Pareto front per checkpoint, and 3-5 representative-cell deep dives.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Rsync results back to local task folder, destroy Vast.ai instance, write costs.json (actual billed amount) + remote_machines_used.json (instance specs + timestamps).

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare best Pareto cells' DSI and firing rates to published mouse RGC measurements; flag any cell that exceeds the biologically plausible range.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Author results_summary.md + results_detailed.md (with Pareto figure, hypervolume trajectory, 3-5 representative-cell figures, REQ-1..REQ-12 coverage). Render Typst PDF.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Author results/suggestions.json (e.g., tier-stratify the best 3 Pareto cells; spatial morphology re-optimisation; add NaP/etc to the parameter set).

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, mark task.json status=completed, push, PR, merge.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: t0019's literature survey already covers V_half / tau priors for the 12 channels; no new lit gap.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: task scope (BoTorch qNEHVI on 25-d) is already well-defined; alternative algorithms documented in Risks #3.
